relationships.subject: Bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Bradykinin, a well-known pain modulator, has also been shown to activate TRPA1 in CHO cells via a G protein-coupled receptor mechanism involving phospholipase C

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) transactivates TRPA1 to control neovascularization and macrophage infiltration

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: There are several known agonists of TRPV1, the most well-known being capsaicin.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPA1 and TRPV1 interact by forming a complex on the plasma membrane of neurons, allowing TRPV1 to modulate TRPA1 by controlling its voltage–current relationships
